description_en: Queries health checks that are associated with a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeHealthChecks查询智能接入网关实例下的健康检查实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-health-checks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-qi0p07ld5q86k30000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHealthChecks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the health check
parameters.name: hc_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the health check.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查实例名称。

长度为2~100个字符，以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前分页页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页展示时，每页的列表条目数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

HealthCheck.description_en: An array that consists of details about the health checks

Description.description_en: The description of the health check

DstIpAddr.description_en: The destination IP address of the health check

DstPort.description_en:
The destination port of the health check.

This feature is not supported
DstPort.description_zh:
健康检查的目的端口。

该功能目前不支持

FailCountThreshold.description_en:
The maximum number of failed probes before a health check is declared failed.

Valid values: 1 to 15.

Default value: 3
FailCountThreshold.description_zh:
连续探测失败次数阈值。

数值范围：1~15。

默认值：3

HcInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the health check

Name.description_en: The name of the health check

ProbeCount.description_en:
The number of probes performed per health check.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 1
ProbeCount.description_zh:
每次健康检查探测次数。

数值范围：1~20。

默认值：1

ProbeInterval.description_en:
The time interval at which probes are performed. The next probe does not start before the current one is complete.

Valid values: 1000 to 60000.

Default value: 2000.

Unit: milliseconds
ProbeInterval.description_zh:
健康检查探测间隔，一次探测未完成情况下，不会发起下一次探测。

数值范围：1000~60000。

默认值：2000。

单位：毫秒

ProbeTimeout.description_en:
The timeout period of a probe.

Valid values: 10 to 30000.

Default value: 1000.

Unit: milliseconds
ProbeTimeout.description_zh:
一次探测的超时时间。

数值范围：10~30000。

默认值：1000。

单位：毫秒

RelationCount.description_en: The number of routes that are associated with the health check
RelationCount.description_zh: 关联健康检查实例的路由数量

RttFailThreshold.description_en:
The number of times that the maximum round-trip time (RTT) is exceeded before an alert is triggered.

Valid values: 1 to 15.

Default value: 3
RttFailThreshold.description_zh:
时延阈值触发次数。 

数值范围：1~15。

默认值：3

RttThreshold.description_en:
The maximum RTT.

Valid values: -1 and 1 to 5000.

Default value: -1. This value indicates that the RTT threshold is not specified.

Unit: milliseconds
RttThreshold.description_zh:
双向时延阈值。

数值范围：-1或1~5000。

默认值：-1，表示不设置双向时延阈值。

单位：毫秒

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance

SrcIpAddr.description_en: The source IP address of the health check

SrcPort.description_en:
The source port of the health check.

This feature is not supported
SrcPort.description_zh:
健康检查的源端口。

该功能目前不支持

Status.description_en:
The status of the health check. Valid values:

success: The health check was successful.
failed: The health check failed.
unknown: The health check was not started
Status.description_zh:
健康检查状态：

success：成功。
failed：失败。
unknown：未开始

Type.description_en: The type of the packet used in the health check. Only ICMP_ECHO is supported
Type.description_zh: 健康检查报文类型，目前仅支持ICMP_ECHO

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前分页的页码。默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
PageSize.description_zh: 分页展示时，每页的列表条目数。默认值为10，最大值为50

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
